html:
The Elephant Cave and Ma Da Valley Jungle Trek is a perfect one day adventure for nature lovers seeking peace, discovery, and a touch of adventure.

Trek deep into Phong Nha – Ke Bang National Park, explore Elephant Cave, swim in the crystal-clear waters of Ma Da Valley and Tra Ang Cave, and enjoy a nutritious jungle BBQ lunch.

This tour is suitable for everyone over 9 years old under adult supervision. It offers a moderate trekking challenge while allowing you to experience the jungle, rivers, caves, and local culture of Phong Nha.

For travelers seeking more adventure, consider the Pygmy Exploration 2 Days 1 Night. For easier options, there are tours like Paradise Cave & Phong Nha Cave or Dark Cave and Paradise Cave, all part of our Phong Nha Tours.

TOUR ITINERARY

08:00 – Pick up at your hotel or homestay in Phong Nha by Phong Nha Locals’ private car and transfer to Jungle Boss’s headquarters.

08:30 – Briefing on environmental protection, safety rules, and trekking preparation.

08:45 – Depart for the trail to start the jungle trek.

10:00 – 11:00 – Trek to Elephant Cave. Explore the 60-meter-high, 300-meter-long cave and learn about its history from your guide.

12:00 – 12:45 – Trek to Ma Da Valley and Crystal Lake. Swim in the cool blue waters and enjoy a BBQ lunch with local dishes. Vegetarian options available upon request.

14:00 – 15:00 – Continue trekking to Tra Ang Cave.

15:45 – 16:30 – Swim 600 meters inside Tra Ang Cave, explore the cave’s interior, and enjoy the unique jungle experience.

17:00 – 17:30 – Trek back to the trailhead and enjoy a cold drink (beer or soda) before returning.

17:30 – Private car returns you to your hotel or homestay in Phong Nha.

WHAT TO BRING

  • Long pants and long sleeves to protect against insects

  • Swimming suit

  • Spare socks

  • Small backpack for essentials

  • Waterproof bag for phone

  • Hat, sunglasses, sunscreen, insect repellent, bandages, wound cleaning solution

  • Optional: personal trekking shoes if our sizes do not fit

We provide trekking shoes, towels, and sandals (sizes 36–45).

PRICE

75 USD per person

INCLUSIONS

  • Professional tour guide and porter team

  • Pick-up & drop-off by private car

  • Entrance fee (400,000 VND/person) and VAT

  • Safety equipment

  • All food and drinks, lunch, and snacks

  • Free use of towels and shoes/sandals

  • Travel insurance (maximum coverage 50,000,000 VND/case)

EXCLUSIONS

  • Other personal expenses

  • Gratuities

CHILD POLICY

  • Children from 9 years old can join this tour
